security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG vector load/store emulation writes to destination vector register elements beyond the trap index or trimmed vl boundary when VECTOR_LOAD_PAST_TRAP=false or VECTOR_FF_UPDATE_PAST_TRIM="update_none" is required by the profile, OR fails to properly set vill on reserved vtype encodings when VILL_SET_ON_RESERVED_VTYPE=true, allowing guest code to execute vector instructions with an illegal vtype configuration that produces undefined element updates.
security_spec.summary: New vector parameters formalize implementation-defined trap boundary behavior, vill-on-reserved-vtype, and fractional LMUL constraints; QEMU TCG must enforce these at bit level or guest-triggered traps during fault-only-first loads will corrupt destination register state beyond the trap index, and illegal vtype configurations will execute undefined vector operations.
